mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the unemployment rate above 9.0% triggers a loss of labor market confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such instances are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > 0.03 over the 5-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent upward trends in GDP demand (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window despite sustained high proxy values, or 60-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a monetary tightening cycle, raising borrowing costs and compressing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > 0.03 over the 20-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflationary pressures reflected in rising CPIAUCSL indexes trigger central bank rate hikes, leading to reduced equity valuations and negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in inflationary periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > 0.03 over the 5-day window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in employment levels (PAYEMS) below 130,000 signals weakening labor market conditions, prompting market pessimism and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such episodes are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > 0.03 over the 20-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in both GDP demand (GDPC1) and housing-related demand (HOUST) creates a virtuous cycle of economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window despite sustained high proxy values, or 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong simultaneous growth in industrial production (INDPRO) and demand for goods (RSAFS) reflects a balanced supply-demand dynamic, fostering market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window despite sustained high proxy values, or 60-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
